data.name: Sharwanrath
data.long_meaning: Sharwanrath is a powerful Hindu name, derived from the Sanskrit words ‘shara’ (arrow) and ‘vrath’ (war). It is believed to be the name of the Hindu god of war, Indra, who is known to wield a powerful thunderbolt and has control over the sky and rain. Sharwanrath is a name that signifies strength, power, and courage, making it an excellent choice for a baby boy.

data.cultural_impact: Sharwanrath is a significant name in Hindu mythology, symbolizing bravery, character, and strength attributed to Lord Indra, the Hindu deity of war, rain, and thunder. The name bears the resonating influence of the powerful and formidable warrior god, inspiring individuals to rise above challenges with unwavering courage and unwavering determination.
data.spiritual_significance: Sharwanrath holds deep spiritual significance as it embodies the divinity of Lord Indra, a revered Hindu god. Individuals bearing this name are believed to possess the god's attributes, including the ability to overcome adversity and harness the power of the elements – rain, wind, and thunder – to bend them to their will. Additionally, the name encourages the internal fortitude needed to thrive in times of personal strife, aligning oneself with the higher consciousness and resilience associated with divine protection.
